dialogue.text: Kɔ́mɛ mɔ́kɔ kɔ́mba kɔ́ta na komputerí yango ezali na problème.
dialogue.translation: Now this with the computer has a problem.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mɔ́nɛ nákoti kíko ezali problème?
dialogue.translation: Just what is the problem?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bí nakɔ́ kɔ́lɔka, yango ekɔ́mi kɔ́ta mbala míngi.
dialogue.translation: If I go to click, it does it many times.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kaka soki okɔ́mba logiciel ya sécurité, ezali kɔ́ta na ntína.
dialogue.translation: Only if you use security software, it happens for a reason.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ah, mɛ́i nákoti kɔ́mba yango?
dialogue.translation: Ah, how can I do with that?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kɔ́mba mɔ́kɔ, tɛ́lɛma ba technicien.
dialogue.translation: With this, call the technicians.

key_phrases.phrase: Kɔ́mɛ mɔ́kɔ kɔ́mba kɔ́ta na komputerí yango ezali na problème.
key_phrases.translation: Now this with the computer has a problem.

key_phrases.phrase: Bí nakɔ́ kɔ́lɔka, yango ekɔ́mi kɔ́ta mbala míngi.

scenario: Renting an apartment (first inquiry)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of Lingala

vocabulary.note: Can refer to a physical or metaphorical path.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nzonge, kaka na nzela ya kɔ́ta oyo ezali na mɔ́kɔ mɔ́nɛ?
dialogue.translation: Excuse me, is this the only way to find a house available this month?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eh, boye, soki ozali na mpo na kopesa yango, kɔ́mɛ ezali mɔ́kɔ.
dialogue.translation: Yes, like this, if you’re looking for it, there’s already a month available.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ah, mɔ́nɛ nakoki tɛka yango?
dialogue.translation: Oh, can I take it now?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eh, kaka tika mpo na dokumɛnt oyo ezali na.
dialogue.translation: Yes, only leave the documents that are needed.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Boyesalemi, nakoki kɔ́mɛ?
dialogue.translation: Thank you, can I do it already?
